book.title: Introduction to Probability
book.author: Joseph K. Blitzstein and Jessica Hwang

predict.question: What is the mean of +8 half the time and 0 otherwise?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Expected value summarizes a distribution without determining every outcome.
modelBoundary: The two means are {A} and {B}. One case can give zero or eight; the other always gives four. Equal means discard this difference.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? The means are exact. This does not measure risk preference or recommend either option.
